question: Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between computers, desktops and laptops.
solution:
The Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between computers, desktops and laptops is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73a9c8ef0d35f112af7ec76764eb4fbfde57ab96f57591b91930ce43adc07a59.png] 

Laptop are subset of computers generally referred as portable computers.

Desktop are subsets of computer generally referred as stationary computers.

Laptop and desktop are different type of computers.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
